```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install("GEOquery")
library(GEOquery)
library(dplyr)
gse <- getGEO("GSE125583", GSEMatrix = TRUE)
gse <- gse[[1]]
pData_GSE125583 <- pData(phenoData(gse))
write.csv(pData_GSE125583, "GSE125583_pData.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r}
colnames(pData_GSE125583)
pheno <- pData_GSE125583 %>%
    select(title, geo_accession, description, "age:ch1", "braak.score:ch1", "case id:ch1", "diagnosis:ch1", "Sex:ch1", "tissue:ch1")%>%
    filter(description == "repeated in GSE95587: NA")
```
